scorecard.rationale: No controlled study isolates refined coconut oil for postural instability in Parkinson disease or outside it. The Parkinson baseline figure (MVP-2024) plots only an unquantified tile without numeric coefficient, confidence interval, or oil grade, while PRO-PD observational analyses report only composite total scores. The multiple-sclerosis balance report (PMID36594273) bundled extra-virgin oil with EGCG, had baseline imbalance (49 vs 43), and reported within-arm tests only, while the Parkinson MCT ketogenic study (PMID38561682) showed no clear mobility difference. The claim therefore moves from legacy 51 to open. Traced the olive and coconut oil review to the earlier baseline cohort. For coconut oil, the further income-adjusted total association was −20.2 points (95% CI −31.0 to −9.4) per frequency category. The original had no refining grade or postural-instability coefficient; it is part of the same research program already covered.
